snippet.title: Dune: Awakening - Filmic Archive DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching September 22 on PC, XBOX, and PlayStation 5, the Filmic Archive DLC brings iconic looks inspired by Dune: Part One and Dune: Part Two to Arrakis. 

Wear the Aegis of the Unwalked Path armor, inspired by Paul Atreides’ visions of Fremen holy warriors in Dune: Part Two. Brave the elements in the Caladan Stormcoat, worn by Paul and Duke Leto in Dune: Part One. The DLC also includes additional film-inspired outfits, plus an extensive 73-piece Sardaukar building set to bring the feared Imperial warriors’ distinctive style to your base and more. 

Filmic Archive will be available for $9.99 on all supported platforms.
